items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: which was like the precursor of Mike Douglas’ show.

ctx.x: He sent me — I think the first sub he sent me on was with Tyree Glenn’s quartet. And Tyree had like a sort of happy hour gig at The Round Table on 50th Street and Third Avenue, which was a pretty popular restaurant at the time. It had medieval décor and his quartet was Tommy Flanagan, Tommy Potter and Elvin. And they used to do remotes on Kate Smith’s afternoon show which came on I think at four o’clock, which was like the precursor of Mike Douglas’ show. In fact I think that was from Philly too.
